description: Capex of 700 Euro/(t/a) (not inflated), a lower bound from brownfield conversions, since JRC-EU-TIMES (about 2,283 Euro/(t/a)) describes an integrated greenfield mill: Stora Enso Oulu (about 1,333 Euro/(t/a), https://www.storaenso.com/en/newsroom/regulatory-and-investor-releases/2022/10/stora-enso-invests-in-conversion-to-accelerate-growth-in-renewable-packaging), Stora Enso Langerbrugge (about 571 Euro/(t/a), https://paperage.com/2022news/06-07-2022stora-enso-langerbrugge-conversion.html) and Kotkamills BM2 (about 425-450 Euro/(t/a), https://www.asiapapermarkets.com/kotkamills-starts-up-new-consumer-board-machine-bm2-in-finland-capacity-400000-tyr-of-nordic-folding-boxboard-and-recyclable-barrier-board/).
